user_story: As a user, I want to interact with action buttons on the Challenging DOM page so that I can perform actions on the data table. Acceptance criteria: When I click on the button with class 'button alert' and text 'bar', it should be visible on the page. The button with class 'button success' and text 'qux' should also be visible. The button with class 'button' and text 'baz' should be present. The page should not navigate away when these buttons are clicked, and I should remain on the Challenging DOM page.
